/** * sticky-header — vendored from the UI Engine preset library (axiestudio). * Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://axiestudio.github.io/UI_Engine/registry/r/sticky-header.json * Source of truth: UI/ — do not edit vendored copies blindly. */ import * as React from "react" import { useScroll, useMotionValueEvent } from "motion/react" import { InView } from "@/components/primitives/in-view" import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" // ═══ JOB Sticky header — a bar that condenses on scroll. // ═══ EMOTION Quiet utility, always within reach. // ═══ SIGNATURE Header that shrinks + gains a blur background once you scroll. export type StickyHeaderProps = { brand?: string items?: { id: string; label: string; href?: string }[] cta?: string className?: string } export function StickyHeader({ brand = "STUDIO", items = [{ id: "a", label: "Work" }, { id: "b", label: "Services" }, { id: "c", label: "About" }], cta = "Start", className }: StickyHeaderProps) { const [condensed, setCondensed] = React.useState(false) const { scrollY } = useScroll() useMotionValueEvent(scrollY, "change", (y) => setCondensed(y > 24)) return (
{brand}
{items.map((i) => ( {i.label} ))}

SCROLL — THE BAR CONDENSES

A sticky header that gets out of the way.

Scroll down to watch the header slim down and gain a blur backdrop — it stays reachable without dominating.
